text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It's finally here, Trainer. The autumn
Tenno
Sho—my race against Oguri...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'm not here to jog. My goal is first
place. I fully
intend to win!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
If I don't, then I can't call myself the
greatest
villain ever.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
We've done all sorts of training to reach
our goal.
All that's left is...
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's go for a sure victory.
Yeah, let's go for a surefire win.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I haven't practiced my villain voice at
all.
How are
the fans going to get excited
now?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Heheheh, you naughty child. ♪ How
dare you
defy me? Kneel before your
master!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Beg for my forgiveness, and you might
yet receive
it... ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
R-right? I'm actually enjoying myself
quite a bit...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
But I don't think I should be.
I'll tone it
down a
smidge if I win!
